calls.video_title: Costco is One of the Best Retailers on the Planet | COST Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: $956-957 (stated current); upgraded to BUY on 21 Sep at ~$890-898 (stated); forward P/E 38 (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated — he states in-video he is reiterating his buy recommendation (dated 13 Oct in the video) after upgrading COST to a buy on 21 Sep for the first time in many years: at 38x forward it still trades at a relatively attractive valuation it rarely reaches (usually 40s, even 50+), with a little more time to buy left; a further rise would evaporate the margin of safety. Consistent with his tracked 26 Sep COST BUY — no flip.
calls.base_case: $303B TTM revenue with roughly 10% of Walmart's locations yet almost half Walmart's sales; ~90% membership renewal; 3.85% operating margin by design (savings passed to customers); ROIC 22%, more than twice its cost of capital, helped by selling inventory before paying suppliers.
calls.bull_case: Sales per store, sales per square foot and inventory turnover outperform Walmart, Target and Home Depot; the premium multiple historically sits in the 40s-50s forward P/E.
calls.bear_case: Razor-thin margins leave little buffer, and if the price rises a little more he would say it is too late to buy and wait for a better opportunity, however great the business.

calls.video_title: Should Investors Buy Costco Stock Instead of Walmart Stock? | COST Stock Analysis WMT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Comparative pick over WMT — Costco more fairly valued; inventory turnover 15.1 vs Walmart 12, expansion runway (less than 1/10th Walmart's store count yet nearly half the revenue).
calls.base_case: DCF $843 vs market $900; consistent with his prior COST BUY — no flip.
calls.bull_case: Store expansion + e-commerce growth (nearly 2x overall revenue growth) reignites the premium multiple.
calls.bear_case: Forward P/E 36.3 is still rich for a 3.8% margin retailer; any comp-sales miss de-rates it.

calls.collab_byline: BWB - Business With Brian and Dividendology

calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $843 vs ~$897 market (only 6% overvalued; fwd P/E 36)
calls.thesis: First BUY since ~2021/22 — stock down ~20% from highs is a rare fairly-valued entry; would do half before and half after Sep 24 earnings.
calls.base_case: DCF $843 vs market $897 — within margin of safety; 9% US comp sales (Aug), 17.9% digital growth, 90%+ membership renewal, 22.6% ROIC.
calls.bull_case: Earnings beat reignites the premium multiple; compounding at near-historic low relative valuation.
calls.bear_case: Valuation still 36x forward; a soft quarter on Sep 24 extends the de-rating despite quality.
